title: Straightforward Vehicle System Use
summary: Feedback centers on how straightforward the vehicle system and features are to use and locate, but many sampled fragments are too brief or context-limited to assign a clear sentiment consistently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the operating system and feature layout as easy to use, intuitive, and straightforward to locate.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention straightforward use, parking ease, purchase simplicity, and difficulty learning the system, but the short or context-limited excerpts make sentiment assignment unclear.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a clearer sentiment readout.
The examples mix system usability with other subjects such as parking and the buying process, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Several excerpts are very short and lack enough context to distinguish clearly between praise, comparison, and complaint.
